project.title: Launch of a New Semi-Automated Assembly Cell
project.objective: Plan and launch a semi-automated assembly cell to improve throughput and quality for small electromechanical products.
deliverables: Documented layout and workflow for the new assembly cell
Standard operating procedures for each workstation
Commissioned and tested machinery and tooling
Quality control and rework handling checklist
Training session and quick-reference guides for operators
Go-live readiness report with initial performance checks
constraints: Cell must fit into existing shop floor footprint and power layout
Minimal production downtime during installation and switchover
Compliance with safety and lockout/tagout procedures
Use mostly existing machines and tools with limited new purchases
Standard work must be understandable for multi-skilled operators
Initial launch must be completed within the agreed timebox

risks.risk: Unexpected machine failures delay commissioning of the cell.
risks.mitigation: Schedule preventive checks before install and keep spare parts and backup manual process ready.

risks.risk: Layout causes bottlenecks or unsafe material flows.
risks.mitigation: Run dry-runs with mock parts, review with safety officer, and adjust layout before finalizing.

risks.risk: Operators are not comfortable with new procedures and make errors.
risks.mitigation: Provide hands-on training, simple visual work instructions, and a supervised pilot shift.

risks.risk: Electrical or pneumatic capacity is insufficient for added equipment.
risks.mitigation: Have technician verify loads in advance and stage phased activation of machines.

risks.risk: Quality issues arise due to new handling and assembly sequence.
risks.mitigation: Define extra in-process checks for first batches and track defects closely for quick correction.

themes.theme: Assembly cell layout and material flow
themes.why_relevant: All roles must align on workstation order, space, and how parts move to avoid congestion.
Industrial machinery mechanics lead setup, testing, and long-term serviceability of equipment.
Clear steps and checks reduce rework and ensure consistent output from the new cell.
New cell must respect safety rules and reduce strain for operators handling parts and tools.
Operators need structured onboarding to the new process to reach target throughput safely.

themes.theme: Coordination of move and minimal downtime
themes.why_relevant: Mover and mechanics must coordinate relocation so production impact stays limited.

backlog.task: Draft initial assembly cell layout and workstation sequence
definition_of_done: Layout sketch created with positions for each workstation and buffer
Material flow arrows and operator paths indicated
Reviewed once with industrial machinery mechanic for feasibility

backlog.task: Validate machine and utility requirements for the new cell
definition_of_done: List of machines and tools for each station completed
Power, air, and safety requirements documented
No conflicts with existing shop utilities identified or mitigation noted

backlog.task: Define standard work steps for PCB assembly station
definition_of_done: Step-by-step list for PCB assembly created
Critical quality points and IPC-related checks noted
Cycle time estimate per unit documented

backlog.task: Define standard work steps for mechanical sub-assembly station
definition_of_done: Sequence of mechanical assembly steps documented
Torque, alignment, and visual inspection points listed
Required tools and fixtures identified

backlog.task: Plan and document material movement and staging
definition_of_done: Inbound and outbound material routes mapped
Staging areas and racks defined with capacities
Handling equipment and safety considerations listed

backlog.task: Create preventive maintenance checklist for cell equipment
definition_of_done: Checklist covering daily, weekly, and monthly tasks drafted
Includes lubrication, inspections, and test runs
Reviewed with electromechanical engineering technician

backlog.task: Specify test and inspection steps for finished units
definition_of_done: Electrical and functional tests defined
Acceptance criteria and rework rules documented
Linked to standard work for final station

backlog.task: Prepare safety and lockout/tagout instructions for the cell
definition_of_done: Hazards for each machine identified
Lockout/tagout steps listed for maintenance
Instructions shared with all cell operators

backlog.task: Develop quick-reference visual guides for operators
definition_of_done: One-page visual guide per station drafted
Includes photos or diagrams of correct assembly
Reviewed by relevant assembler roles for clarity

backlog.task: Plan relocation of existing equipment into the new cell
definition_of_done: Move sequence and timing documented
Required lifting equipment and manpower listed
Plan minimizes overlap with production hours

backlog.task: Run pilot production and capture initial performance data
definition_of_done: Pilot batch produced through full cell flow
Defects, stoppages, and cycle times recorded
List of improvement actions proposed
Status of layout, machines, and procedures summarized
Open issues and risks listed with owners
Recommendation on go-live date shared with stakeholders

artifacts.title: Equipment Commissioning and Maintenance Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Guide mechanics through setup, test runs, and preventive maintenance tasks.

artifacts.title: Standard Work and Quality Control Guide
artifacts.used_for: Describe step-by-step tasks and quality checks for each station in the cell.

artifacts.title: Safety and Lockout/Tagout Instructions
artifacts.used_for: Explain safety rules, hazards, and lockout/tagout steps for the new cell.

artifacts.title: Pilot Run Performance Log
artifacts.used_for: Record cycle times, stoppages, and defects during pilot production.

artifacts.title: Go-Live Readiness Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Verify that layout, equipment, training, and safety items are complete before launch.

artifacts.title: Equipment Relocation and Downtime Plan
artifacts.used_for: Plan moves of machines and tools with minimal impact on ongoing production.

artifacts.title: Operator Training Session Notes
artifacts.used_for: Capture training agenda, attendance, and follow-up actions for operators.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on target layout, workstation sequence, and material flow for the cell.
threads_plan.trigger: Electromechanical engineering technician shares first draft of the layout sheet A1.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the initial workstation order and material flow for the assembly cell.
Confirm which existing machines will be relocated into the new cell.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and refine standard work and quality checks for each station.
threads_plan.trigger: Printed circuit board assembler posts draft standard work steps for PCB station from T3.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final standard work steps for PCB and mechanical stations.
Select the in-process and final quality checks to include in the guide.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan equipment installation, safety measures, and maintenance routines.
threads_plan.trigger: Industrial machinery mechanic shares draft of commissioning and maintenance checklist A2.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the sequence and timing for equipment installation and test runs.
Approve safety and lockout/tagout instructions for the new cell.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate relocation of equipment and material staging with minimal downtime.
threads_plan.trigger: Mover posts initial relocation and downtime plan based on T5 and T10.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final move schedule and responsibilities for equipment relocation.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot run results and decide on go-live readiness.
threads_plan.trigger: Electromechanical engineering technician shares pilot performance log A5 after first batch.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide whether to proceed with full go-live or run another pilot with adjustments.

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in where each role posts yesterday's progress, today's plan, and blockers.
Twice-weekly layout and safety review to confirm any changes to cell design or procedures.
Weekly pilot readiness or performance recap summarizing key metrics and issues from the cell.
Post-move debrief after equipment relocation to capture lessons learned and update checklists.
